messages:
sophi: quick heads-up — the Python quickstart snippet under /python/quickstart seems to have an async example that doesn't match the released SDK. I hit AttributeError when trying the async client + the doc link 404s. anyone seen this?

kevin: ugh, thanks for flagging. can you paste the snippet + the error? which pip package/version are you on?

sophi: sure — using redwood==0.8.3 from pip. snippet from docs: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

async def main():
    # docs show this as async call
    resp = await client.responses.create("Hello")
    print(resp.output_text)
```
error: AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'responses'
(the same page is also returning a 404 when I click "Python quickstart" from the getting-started nav)

maria: that looks like the new responses.* shape we landed for the beta runtime but the pip package still exposes client.generate / client.chat in 0.8.x. docs were updated ahead of the release. :facepalm:

kevin: ok that explains it. repeating cause we'll need to triage: (1) fix doc to show code that works with 0.8.x, (2) add a prominent version compatibility note and an anchor link for the beta API, (3) fix the broken quickstart link in the nav.

sophi: thanks. can someone patch the quickstart so community users don't hit this? btw the broken link is: https://docs.redwood.inference/python/quickstart — returns 404 for me.

docs-bot: FYI — docs site deploy failed at 2026-02-21T18:02:12Z (CI job docs/build). Error: missing page `python/quickstart` in latest build. Issue opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/721

joe: I can do a small PR to revert the async snippet to the stable API and add a note about async beta. will also pin the example to v0.8 in the code block. prepping now.

kevin: awesome — please add a short sentence: "If you're using redwood>=0.10 (beta), see the async examples here <link-to-beta-anchor>". also add a checklist item to the PR description to update the sample-app README (we had a link to the quickstart there).

joe: noted. also found another broken link in the sample-app README pointing to /examples/python/async-chat — changing that to the new repo path. i'll include both changes in one PR.

maria: pro tip for follow-ups: we should add an automated doc lint that validates excerpts against installed package versions (like running the snippet with pytest/exec). avoids this drift. filing a follow-up ticket.

kevin: filing it now — #1104 (doc-snippet-exec-check). assigning to devex and docs.

sophi: thanks all. after joe's PR merges can someone post the fixed link here? want to update the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:

joe: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/734 — fixes snippet, adds version note, and restores quickstart nav link. waiting for review.

kevin: merging after tests. will also coordinate with release to cut a patch if we need to keep async docs hidden until 0.10 lands.

sophi: lovely — will re-run the tutorial once merged and report back if anything else pops up.

docs-bot: docs PR 734 merged by kevin at 2026-02-22T09:14:03Z — quickstart restored.

sophi: confirmed — quickstart link works and the snippet matches pip package behaviour. closing my onboarding blocker. thanks y'all! :tada:
